zh.title: ADU 基础知识：加州州法底线、JADU 和各市入口
zh.seo_title: 加州 ADU 与 JADU 基础知识｜陈靖
zh.description: 依据 HCD 2026 年 3 月版 ADU Handbook，讲清 ADU 和 JADU 的区别、州法保障的尺寸和审批时限、出租和费用规则，并列出湾区十个城市的官方 ADU 入口。
zh.lead: ADU 可以用来给家人住或出租，也会带来审批、造价、税和保险上的新问题。先看州法给了什么底线，再看你所在城市的具体规定。

en.title: ADU Basics: State Rules, JADUs and City Resources
en.seo_title: California ADU & JADU Basics | Jing Chen
en.description: State ADU and JADU rules from HCD's March 2026 handbook: size, timelines, rental limits and fees, with official ADU pages for ten Bay Area cities.
en.lead: An ADU can house family or bring in rent, and it adds questions on permits, cost, tax and insurance. Start with the state baseline, then check your city's rules.
